translations.zh: 寧宗即位，趙汝愚首薦熹及陳傅良，有旨赴行在奏事。
translations.literal: When Ningzong took the throne, Zhao Ruyu was first to recommend Xi and Chen Fuliang; an edict ordered them to proceed to the traveling palace and report on state affairs.
translations.idiomatic: When Ningzong took the throne, Zhao Ruyu was the first to recommend Zhu Xi and Chen Fuliang; an edict ordered them to proceed to the traveling palace and report on state affairs.

translations.zh: 熹行且辭，除煥章閣待制、侍講，辭，不許。
translations.literal: Xi was on his way but declined; he was appointed Attendant Gentleman at the Huanzhang Pavilion and Lecture Companion; he declined again and was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Xi was already on his way but declined; he was appointed attendant gentleman at the Huanzhang Pavilion and lecture companion, declined again, and was not permitted to refuse.

translations.zh: 入對，首言：「乃者，太皇太后躬定大策，陛下寅紹丕圖，可謂處之以權，而庶幾不失其正。
translations.literal: In audience he first said: "Recently the Grand Empress Dowager herself settled the great decision, and Your Majesty reverently inherited the imperial foundation—this may be called handling affairs with expedience while still not losing what is upright.
translations.idiomatic: In audience he first said, "Recently the Grand Empress Dowager herself settled the great decision, and Your Majesty reverently inherited the imperial foundation. This may be called handling affairs with expedience while still not losing what is upright.

translations.zh: 自頃至今三月矣，或反不能無疑於逆順名實之際，竊為陛下憂之。
translations.literal: From then until now three months have passed, yet some may still harbor doubts at the juncture of legitimacy and nominal reality; I privately worry for Your Majesty.
translations.idiomatic: From then until now three months have passed, yet some may still harbor doubts at the juncture of legitimacy and nominal reality. I worry for Your Majesty.

translations.zh: 猶有可諉者，亦曰陛下之心，前日未嘗有求位之計，今日未嘗忘思親之懷，此則所以行權而不失其正之根本也。
translations.literal: There is still something that may be alleged in excuse: it is said that in Your Majesty's heart, you never before harbored a plan to seek the throne, and today you have never forgotten the longing to honor your parent—this is the root by which one may exercise expedience without losing what is upright.
translations.idiomatic: There is still something that may be alleged in excuse: Your Majesty never before harbored a plan to seek the throne, and today has never forgotten the longing to honor your parent. This is the root by which one may exercise expedience without losing what is upright.

translations.zh: 充未嘗求位之心，以盡負罪引慝之誠，充未嘗忘親之心，以致溫凊定省之禮，而大倫正，大本立矣。」
translations.literal: Fill the heart that never sought the throne, to fulfill the sincerity of accepting guilt and drawing blame upon oneself; fill the heart that never forgets one's parent, to perform the rites of tending comfort and attending in person—and the great human bonds are set right, and the great foundation is established."
translations.idiomatic: Fill the heart that never sought the throne, to fulfill the sincerity of accepting guilt and drawing blame upon oneself; fill the heart that never forgets one's parent, to perform the rites of tending comfort and attending in person—and the great human bonds are set right and the great foundation is established."

translations.zh: 復面辭待制、侍講，上手劄：「卿經術淵源，正資勸講，次對之職，勿復勞辭，以副朕崇儒重道之意。」
translations.literal: He again declined the Attendant Gentleman and Lecture Companion posts in person; the emperor sent him a handwritten note: "Your classical learning runs deep at its source and is precisely what I need for exhortation in the lecture hall; in the office of waiting remonstrance, do not again trouble yourself with declining, so as to fulfill my purpose of honoring the Ru and valuing the Way."
translations.idiomatic: He again declined the attendant gentleman and lecture companion posts in person. The emperor sent him a handwritten note: "Your classical learning runs deep at its source and is precisely what I need for exhortation in the lecture hall. In the office of waiting remonstrance, do not again trouble yourself with declining, so as to fulfill my purpose of honoring the Ru and valuing the Way."
